title: Fluent but Fallible: Benchmarking Hallucination and Factual Reliability in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced natural language processing and artificial intelligence applications through their capabilities in reasoning, text generation and knowledge retrieval. However, LLMs are still vulnerable to two important challenges: hallucination, generating factually incorrect or fabricated content, and response deviation, meaning systematic deviations from ground-truth responses. These limitations raise serious concerns regarding reliability and trustworthiness in academic and research environments. This study offers a thorough comparative analysis using a variety of metrics of ten advanced LLMs ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude~3.5~Sonnet, LLaMA~3, Mistral, Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek~V3, Falcon, and Gemma based on a benchmark consisting of 70 carefully designed academic prompts across four complexity levels: Basic, Explanation, Advanced, and Tricky, evaluated in February 2025 on specific model versions. Ea

translated_title: 流畅但易错：大型语言模型中幻觉与事实可靠性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过其在推理、文本生成和知识检索方面的能力，显著推动了自然语言处理和人工智能应用的发展。然而，LLM仍然容易受到两个重要挑战的影响：幻觉，即生成事实上错误或虚构的内容；以及响应偏差，即系统性地偏离真实答案。这些局限性引发了学术界和研究环境中对可靠性和可信度的严重担忧。本研究采用多种指标，对十个先进的LLM进行了全面的对比分析，包括ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 3.5 Sonnet、LLaMA 3、Mistral、Grok、Perplexity、DeepSeek V3、Falcon和Gemma。基准测试由70个精心设计的学术提示组成，涵盖四个复杂度级别：基础、解释、高级和技巧性，于2025年2月针对特定模型版本进行评估。
tldr: 本研究通过70个覆盖四个复杂度级别的学术提示，对十个主流大语言模型的幻觉和事实可靠性进行了系统的基准对比评估，揭示了尽管模型语言流畅但仍存在事实错误和响应偏差的可靠性风险。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks hallucination and factual reliability across ten leading LLMs using 70 carefully designed academic prompts at four complexity levels, revealing that despite their fluency, these models remain vulnerable to factual errors and response deviations.
